issues.description: Forbidden template placeholder: url = ""  # CI fills this. Code style rule 5 explicitly bans this pattern as '未完成' (incomplete). The recipe url field should be filled with the actual repository URL.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set url to the actual Conan recipe repository URL, e.g. url = "https://cnb.cool/yourorg/ohos-build-in-harmonyos". Remove the '# CI fills this' comment.

issues.description: patch_description does not follow the required format '{序号} {描述}' (number prefix with space-separated words). Code style rule 12 expects descriptions derived from the patch filename with hyphens replaced by spaces, e.g. '0001 src CMakeLists.txt'. Current descriptions are full English sentences without the number prefix.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change patch_description to '0001 src CMakeLists.txt' and '0002 version.sh' to match the expected format.

issues.description: BUILD_SHARED_LIBS is set manually in generate() via tc.variables['BUILD_SHARED_LIBS']. In Conan 2.x, CMakeToolchain automatically sets BUILD_SHARED_LIBS based on the 'shared' option, making this line redundant. Additionally, using string 'ON'/'OFF' instead of Python boolean True/False is not best practice.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the manual tc.variables['BUILD_SHARED_LIBS'] line. CMakeToolchain handles this automatically when the 'shared' option is declared.

issues.description: Notes reference old/deleted patch file names with swapped numbers. Notes say 'version.sh — bash 路径修复 (0001-version.sh.patch)' and 'src/CMakeLists.txt — SOVERSION 空值处理 (0002-src-CMakeLists.txt.patch)', but the actual patches are 0001-src-CMakeLists.txt.patch and 0002-version.sh.patch. The patch numbering and file associations are swapped.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update notes to reference correct patch names: 'src/CMakeLists.txt — SOVERSION 空值处理 (0001-src-CMakeLists.txt.patch)' and 'version.sh — bash 路径修复 (0002-version.sh.patch)'.

issues.description: Version inconsistency: notes mention 'jansson 2.14' as a dependency, but conanfile.py declares 'jansson/2.15.1' and manifest.yaml lists 'jansson 2.15.1'. The notes appear to have an outdated version number.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update notes.md to say 'jansson 2.15.1' to match conanfile.py and manifest.yaml.

issues.description: Docstring claims 'codec support (deflate, snappy, lzma)' but snappy and lzma are not declared as Conan requirements. The build may silently disable these codecs if they are not found by CMake, producing a package with reduced functionality compared to what the description claims. The knowledge_gained in manifest.yaml also mentions 'snappy 是 C++ 库' implying snappy is used.
issues.fix_suggestion: If snappy and lzma codec support is desired, add self.requires('snappy/1.1.10') and self.requires('xz_utils/5.6.2') (or equivalent) to requirements(). Otherwise, update the docstring to clarify which codecs are actually supported.

issues.description: Missing 'name' field. Code style rule 14 shows manifest.yaml should start with 'name: avro-c'. The current manifest starts directly with 'version: "1.12.0"'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'name: avro-c' as the first field in manifest.yaml.

issues.description: Uses 'build.system: cmake' (nested under build:) instead of the flat 'build_system: cmake' format shown in code style rule 14. While the nested format may work for documentation purposes, it does not match the expected schema.
issues.fix_suggestion: If the flat format is expected, add 'build_system: cmake' at the top level. If the nested format is intentional, document this as a format variant.

issues.description: Unused import: 'import os' is declared but only referenced in a commented-out line (the self.run() alternative). Unused imports should be removed before merging.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove 'import os' from the test_package/conanfile.py, or uncomment the alternative test method if it is intended to be used.

issues.description: Patch makes avropipe and avromod executables conditional on BUILD_SHARED_LIBS (changing 'if (NOT WIN32)' to 'if (NOT WIN32 AND BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)'). These are standalone executables that link against avro-static, not avro-shared. Making them depend on BUILD_SHARED_LIBS means they won't build in static mode (the default). This appears inconsistent — avrocat and avroappend remain unconditional.
issues.fix_suggestion: Verify whether avropipe/avromod truly require shared libraries. If not, keep their condition as 'if (NOT WIN32)' and only apply BUILD_SHARED_LIBS to the avro-shared library block.

issues.description: Class name 'AvrocTestConan' does not preserve the capital 'C' in 'avro-c'. The main conanfile.py uses 'AvroCConan' correctly. For consistency, the test class should be 'AvroCTestConan'.
issues.fix_suggestion: Rename class from 'AvrocTestConan' to 'AvroCTestConan' to match the capitalization convention.

issues.description: patch_classification entries have 'guard: pending' for both patches, indicating the guard classification is incomplete. This should be resolved before merging (e.g., set to 'none' if no platform guard is needed, or the appropriate guard type).
issues.fix_suggestion: Set the 'guard' field to the actual classification (e.g., 'none', '__OHOS__', etc.) instead of 'pending'.

issues.description: Notes mention 'avro-c-1.12.0-ohos-aarch64.tar.gz | 2.3MB | 预编译安装包' as a deliverable. While no binary file is included in the PR (no .so/.a/.tar.gz in changed_files), documenting a pre-compiled package as a deliverable may be misleading. Rule R19 prohibits pre-compiled binaries in PRs.
issues.fix_suggestion: Clarify in notes that the pre-compiled package is a local build artifact only, not part of the PR. All CI builds must produce artifacts from source.

issues.description: CMake project and target name uses a hyphen: 'test_avro-c'. While CMake allows hyphens in target names since 3.x, it can cause issues with some CMake functions and is not best practice.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider using underscores: 'project(test_avro_c C)' and 'add_executable(test_avro_c test.c)' for safer CMake compatibility.

summary: Audit of feat/avro-c-1.12.0 PR (13 changed files). VERDICT: PASS (no P0/P1 issues). No deceptive behavior found: (1) test_package/test.c substantially exercises the avro-c API — schema parsing, datum creation, field set/get, type checking, resource cleanup (R34 satisfied); (2) sha256 '74333d43...' is 64 hex chars, not a placeholder/fake; (3) manifest status 'built' is consistent with notes; (4) test() calls cmake.test(), not skipped (R9 satisfied); (5) no #ifdef __OHOS__ empty stubs; (6) no pre-compiled binaries in PR. Recipe correctness (P1 checks): version 1.12.0 is upstream (first adaptation), requirements use proper name/version slash format, no hardcoded paths in build(), no Linux-only checks that miss OHOS, Conan 2.x API used correctly. 3 P2 issues found (forbidden url placeholder, patch_description format, redundant BUILD_SHARED_LIBS). 11 P3 suggestions (notes inconsistencies, missing manifest name field, unused import, patch logic concern for avropipe/avromod, class naming, etc.). The PR is acceptable for merge after addressing P2 issues.
